What clothes makes for good finds at children's stores for adult women?

I have only purchased t-shirts from the children's section, not anything fitted. I do love thrift stores and vintage clothing. If you like the retro look I'd say to check out the vintage shops. I also sew, even if you're a novice some alterations are simple and make a big difference in fit. I wouldn't try a complicated alteration like a suit jacket on your first try, but adding darts (and including the waistband in the dart) is a simple way to make the item fit better in the waist. You can then resew the seams of the outer thigh slightly smaller as well, just follow the original seam. This works for anything that is within 3 or 4 dress sizes of your size, after that the cut changes because the proportions change.

There are YouTube videos on how to make a dress form that is your body exactly, and that would be a great tool to restructure or create a garment that will fit you like a glove. It involves lots of duct tape, and you need someone to help cut you out of the form.

If you start using the governing body to act as a gatekeeper for speech, then the people with influence can use it to their advantage (e.g. to jail dissenters to their opinions, rather than to jail truly harmful persons).
